String.string:
[EN] Be alert! The protection mission has started.
[ES] ¡Estad atentos! La misión de protección ha comenzado.

[EN] Five minutes elapsed. Keep it up!
[ES] Cinco minutos transcurridos. ¡Sigue así!

[EN] Nine minutes elapsed. Fight on!
[ES] Nueve minutos transcurridos. ¡Sigue luchando!

[EN] Mission complete. Well done!
[ES] Misión completa. ¡Bien hecho!

[EN] Our convoy is under attack!
[ES] ¡Nuestro convoy está bajo ataque!

[EN] Our convoy is taking heavy damage!
[ES] ¡Nuestro convoy está sufriendo daños graves!

[EN] Our convoy is half destroyed!
[ES] ¡Nuestro convoy está medio destruido!

[EN] Our convoy is getting crushed!
[ES] ¡Están aplastando nuestro convoy!

[EN] Our convoy isn't gonna make it!
[ES] ¡Nuestro convoy no va a lograrlo!

[EN] We're about to lose our convoy!
[ES] ¡Estamos a punto de perder nuestro convoy!

[EN] Our convoy is completely destroyed. What a disaster!
[ES] Nuestro convoy está completamente destruido. ¡Qué desastre!

[EN] Reinforcements from Popolion, I hope?
[ES] ¿Refuerzos de Popolion, espero?

[EN] Check on our convoy! Hurry!
[ES] ¡Revisa nuestro convoy! ¡Date prisa!

[EN] You have failed. Teleporting outside in three seconds.
[ES] Has fallado. Teletransportando afuera en tres segundos.
